fields.label: Enable smooth camera transitions
fields.description: Compiles the eased camera follow / camera path code. Turn off to save ROM if you only need the extra lock targets.

fields.label: Enable multiple lock targets
fields.description: Compiles the code that locks the camera onto the median position of several actors. Turn off to save ROM if you only ever lock onto a single actor.

fields.label: Default smoothing speed
fields.description: How fast the camera catches up with its target. 0 = instant, which is the stock camera behaviour. Re-applied on every scene load.

fields.label: Default smoothing path
fields.description: Path the camera takes while catching up with its target. Re-applied on every scene load.
